تعتورن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَوِرْنَ (taʕtawirna) /taʕ.ta.wir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# تُعْتَوَرْنَ (tuʕtawarna) /tuʕ.ta.war.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
